title: Engineering Manager (Platform & Reliability)
description: Lead a platform engineering team responsible for reliable foundations used by multiple product groups. You will coach engineers, set clear delivery goals, guide architecture and incident follow-up, and work with product leadership to prioritize platform investments. The role balances people leadership with technical judgment across cloud infrastructure, developer tooling, and service reliability. We need a manager who builds inclusive, accountable teams, communicates tradeoffs clearly, and uses operational evidence to improve outcomes. Prior experience leading production engineering teams and delivering platform capabilities is required.
requiredSkills: ["Engineering Leadership","People Management","Platform Engineering","SRE","Cloud Infrastructure","Incident Management","Roadmap Planning","Technical Communication"]

title: Junior Data Analyst (Product & Operations)
description: Turn product and operations data into useful answers for teams making day-to-day decisions. You will clean and validate datasets, write SQL queries, prepare dashboards, explain trends, and document assumptions so results can be trusted. The ideal candidate is comfortable with spreadsheets and basic statistics, asks thoughtful questions, and can present findings in plain language. Python or Power BI experience is welcome but not required. This entry-level role includes support from senior analysts and opportunities to learn data modeling and analytics practices.

title: Frontend Developer I (React & TypeScript)
description: Join the product engineering team to build clear, responsive interfaces for customers and internal users. You will implement reusable React components, connect screens to REST APIs, fix UI defects, and add tests with guidance from experienced engineers. We are looking for someone with a strong JavaScript and TypeScript foundation, careful attention to detail, and curiosity about accessibility and performance. This role is a good fit for a new graduate or early-career developer who wants to learn through code reviews and collaborative delivery.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer (IAM & Detection)
description: Strengthen security across cloud infrastructure and production services through practical engineering and measurable controls. You will design least-privilege IAM, improve threat detection and response, review architecture, and automate security checks in delivery pipelines. You will partner with platform and application teams to investigate findings, prioritize remediation, and document evidence for audits. This role needs deep AWS security experience, strong knowledge of networking and identity, and the ability to explain risk clearly. Experience leading incident reviews and improving security operations is highly valued.
requiredSkills: ["AWS Security","IAM","Threat Detection","Incident Response","Cloud Networking","SIEM","Infrastructure as Code","Security Audits","Python"]

title: Product Designer (B2B SaaS & Design Systems)
description: Design practical, polished experiences for complex B2B workflows, from early discovery through delivery. You will interview users, map journeys, prototype interactions, and work closely with product managers and engineers to refine solutions. You will contribute accessible components and usage guidance to a shared design system and validate decisions through usability feedback. The right candidate can explain design rationale, balance customer needs with delivery constraints, and maintain clear files and specifications. Experience designing responsive SaaS products and collaborating in agile teams is required.

title: QA Automation Engineer I (Web & API)
description: Help the quality team make product releases dependable by writing and maintaining automated checks for web and API workflows. You will reproduce reported issues, prepare clear test cases, validate fixes, and learn how tests run in CI. We value basic programming ability, logical problem solving, and clear communication. Familiarity with JavaScript, Playwright or Cypress, HTTP requests, and SQL is helpful; mentorship and structured reviews are part of the role. This opening is intended for a fresher or early-career tester ready to grow practical automation skills.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js & Distributed Systems)
description: Lead the design and delivery of backend services that support high-volume customer workflows. You will build resilient Node.js and TypeScript APIs, model data in PostgreSQL, improve queue and cache usage, and define clear service boundaries. The role includes technical reviews, production troubleshooting, security and performance improvements, and mentoring other engineers. We are looking for strong judgment around reliability, observability, and safe migrations, plus a record of operating distributed services in production. You will work across teams to turn product requirements into maintainable systems.

title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
description: Improve the reliability and delivery speed of services running on AWS and Kubernetes. You will maintain infrastructure as code, build secure CI/CD workflows, monitor production services, and help teams respond to incidents. The role includes capacity planning, cost awareness, access control, and clear runbooks for routine operations. Candidates should have hands-on experience with Linux, Terraform, containers, and cloud networking, along with a practical approach to automation and operational safety. You will partner with software and security engineers on production improvements.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (React & Node.js)
description: Own features across a modern web application, from accessible React interfaces to Node.js services and PostgreSQL persistence. You will work with product and design to clarify requirements, build and document APIs, review code, and improve automated test coverage. We need an engineer who can debug across the stack, make sound tradeoffs, and communicate progress clearly. Production experience with TypeScript, relational data, and cloud-hosted applications is expected. You will also help improve observability and performance as customer usage grows.
